title: Privileged roles are assigned permanently while Privileged Identity Management is available

report.title: {Items.Count} privileged {Plural(Items.Count, 'assignment is', 'assignments are')} permanent rather than eligible

messages.businessImpact: Administrative rights are always active, so a compromised session is immediately an administrative session. Making them eligible means rights exist only while they are being used, and every activation is recorded.
remediation: Convert the assignments listed to eligible in Privileged Identity Management.
Require approval and justification for the highest roles.
Leave emergency access accounts permanently assigned.
